# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** About 11 at start, growing into her mid-teens  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c26 P15](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0015), [v1 c28 P8](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c15 P15](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, glossy dark tresses, and rosy cheeks, inheriting a merry expression from her father. She has a plump figure with dimples, contrasting with Anne's slim stature. She is an inch shorter than Anne and often wears fashionable clothes such as a crimson ulster or a jaunty fur cap and smart jacket.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c19 P35](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0035), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c33 P12](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0012), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 c33 P14](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0014), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)_

## Personality

Diana is cheerful, agreeable, and warm-hearted, frequently laughing before she speaks. She is fond of reading and enjoys sharing stories and fun with her friends. Although raised under strict rules and respectful of authority, she possesses a playful side and deep loyalty toward those she loves.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c19 P57](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0057), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070), [v2 c26 P60](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0060)_

## History

Diana meets Anne Shirley when Anne moves to Green Gables, and the two rapidly become inseparable bosom friends, swearing an oath of lifelong devotion in the garden. They share many childhood adventures, including creating playhouses like Idlewild, starting a story club, and exploring local spots. After accidentally drinking three glasses of currant wine at Green Gables thinking it was raspberry cordial, Diana becomes ill, leading her strict mother to briefly forbid them from playing together; however, Mrs. Barry relents after Anne helps nurse Minnie May through a severe bout of croup. Diana participates in various local escapades, such as accidentally leaping onto Great-Aunt Josephine Barry in the spare-room bed during a sleepover, which surprisingly earns Aunt Josephine's affection and musical sponsorship. Although Diana does not join the Queen's class due to her parents' decision not to send her to college, she remains Anne's closest companion and joins the Avonlea Improvement Society. In her mid-teens, she enters a romantic courtship with Fred Wright.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P23](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0023), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c12 P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c16 P45](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0045), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 c19 P60](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0060), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v1 c19 P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092), [v1 c26 P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c2 P0](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0000), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011)_

## Background by volume

- Named by a schoolmaster who boarded with her family when she was born  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>
- Raised at Orchard Slope near Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- Has a younger sister named Minnie May  <sub>[v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>

## Quotes

> Why, I guess so. I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough.  <sub>[v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>

> Why it’s dreadfully wicked to swear.  <sub>[v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030)</sub>

> You’re a queer girl, Anne. I heard before that you were queer. But I believe I’m going to like you real well.  <sub>[v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>

> Gilbert Blythe? He’s aw’fly handsome, Anne. And he teases the girls something terrible. He just torments our lives out.  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>

> Indeed I will, and I’ll never have another bosom friend—I don’t want to have. I couldn’t love anybody as I love you.  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>
